units.title: 避乱·总旨：官鬼所在的方位和官鬼所克的地方不要去，子孙所在的方位和生我的地方适宜去；留守原处时子孙独发生我只是惊恐一场

rule.yi: 避乱的大旨：官鬼所在的方位，以及官鬼所克的地方，不要去；子孙所在的方位，以及生我的地方，适宜去。如果占的是留守原处，得子孙独自发动生我，只是惊恐一场；占要去的地方也是这样。
rule.en: The main purport of fleeing disorder: do not go to the quarter of Pressure or to the places Pressure controls; it is fit to go to the quarter of Output and to the places that give life to me. If one divines about staying in the old place, and Output alone moves to give life to me, it ends in a fright only; the same holds for divining about a place one is going to.

yi: 人有穷有通，
世道有否有泰。
自己哀叹命薄，
恰好碰上离乱的年头，
每每叹息走投无路，
姑且推演谋求变通的《易》。
于是记录下已经验证过的卦爻，
用来决断当今的贼寇
en: Men have their poverty and their success,
and the world its stagnation and its prosperity.
Lamenting my thin fortune,
I met the season of disorder,
and often sighed at the end of the road,
so I tried working out the Yi for a way of change.
Thus I record the hexagram lines already tested
to decide about the bandits of the present

zh: 官鬼之方并官鬼所克之处，休往；
子孙之方并生我之处，宜去。
如占守旧处，得子孙独发生我，止于惊恐，占往处亦然。
yi: 官鬼所在的方位，以及官鬼所克的地方，不要去；
子孙所在的方位，以及生我的地方，适宜去。
如果占的是留守原处，得子孙独自发动生我，只是惊恐一场；占要去的地方也是这样。
这是这一篇的大旨。
en: Do not go to the quarter of Pressure or to the places Pressure controls;
it is fit to go to the quarter of Output and to the places that give life to me.
If one divines about staying in the old place, and Output alone moves to give life to me, it ends in a fright only; the same holds for divining about a place one is going to.
This is the main purport of the whole chapter.

units.title: 避乱·鬼位兴隆贼势必然猖獗、官爻墓绝人心始得安康：官鬼旺相发动则贼必猖獗，休囚安静又有日辰动爻制它才能安卧无惊

rule.yi: 官鬼旺相发动，贼寇必定猖獗；官鬼休囚安静，再有日辰、动爻制住它，人心才安，可以安睡没有惊扰。
rule.en: If Pressure is strong and moves, the bandits will surely be rampant; if Pressure is resting or trapped and still, and the Day or a moving line controls it, people's hearts are at peace and one can sleep without alarm.

yi: 鬼爻的位置兴旺，
贼寇的势头必然猖獗；
官爻入墓、绝，
人心才能安康
en: If the Pressure position flourishes,
the bandits' strength will surely be rampant;
if the Pressure line is in the tomb or extinction,
then people's hearts find peace

zh: 官鬼旺相发动，贼必猖獗；
若得休囚安静，日辰动爻制它，则安卧无惊。
yi: 官鬼旺相发动，贼必定猖獗；
如果官鬼休囚安静，又有日辰、动爻制住它，就可以安睡没有惊扰。
en: If Pressure is strong and moves, the bandits will surely be rampant;
if Pressure is resting or trapped and still, and the Day or a moving line controls it, one can sleep in peace without alarm.

units.title: 避乱·路上如逢休出外、宅中如遇勿归家：内卦是宅，外卦是路，鬼在外卦动则出外必遇、宜守家，鬼在内卦动则宜躲到外面

rule.yi: 内卦代表家宅，外卦代表道路：鬼爻在外卦发动，出去必定遇到贼寇，宜守在家里；鬼爻在内卦发动，宜躲到外面去。
rule.en: The inner trigram is the house and the outer trigram the road: if Pressure moves in the outer trigram one will surely meet the bandits when going out and should stay at home; if it moves in the inner trigram it is fit to hide outside.

yi: 路上如果遇到（鬼爻发动），就不要出外；
家里如果遇到（鬼爻发动），就不要回家
en: If one meets it on the road, do not go out;
if one meets it in the house, do not go home

zh: 内卦为宅，外卦为路，鬼在外动，出外必遇，宜守家中；
yi: 内卦代表家宅，外卦代表道路；鬼爻在外卦发动，出外必定遇到，宜守在家中；
如果在内卦发动，宜躲到外面去。
en: The inner trigram is the house and the outer trigram the road; if Pressure moves in the outer trigram, one will surely meet them when going out, and should stay at home;
if it moves in the inner trigram, it is fit to hide outside.

units.title: 避乱·动来刑害总教智慧也难逃、变入空亡若被勾留犹可脱：鬼动不伤世任它猖獗也不遭祸，被刑冲克害必难逃，官爻变入死墓空绝是虎头蛇尾

rule.yi: 鬼爻发动但不伤世，任凭它猖獗也不遭祸；如果被它刑冲克害，必定难逃；如果官爻变入死、墓、空、绝，就是虎头蛇尾，虽有凶，却是没有灾咎的征兆，即使被拘留也还有可能脱身。
rule.en: If Pressure moves without injuring the Self, however rampant it is one meets no disaster; if one is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by it, escape is surely hard; if the Pressure line changes into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is a tiger's head and a snake's tail: there is ill, but it is a sign of no blame, and even if one is detained there is still the chance to get free.

yi: （鬼爻）发动来刑害（世爻），
纵然智慧过人也难逃脱；
变入空亡，
如果只是被拘留，还有可能脱身
en: If it moves to punish or harm the Self,
even the wisest cannot escape;
if it changes into Void,
then if one is only detained, there is still the chance to get free

zh: 若鬼动不伤世，任彼猖獗，不遭其祸；
如被刑冲克害，必难逃避；
若官爻变入死墓空绝，则是虎头蛇尾，虽有凶无咎之兆。
yi: 如果鬼爻发动不伤世，任凭他们猖獗，也不会遭到灾祸；
如果被刑冲克害，必定难以逃避；
如果官爻变入死、墓、空、绝，就是虎头蛇尾，虽有凶，却是没有灾咎的征兆。
en: If Pressure moves without injuring the Self, however rampant they are one will not meet the disaster;
if one is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed, escape is surely hard;
if the Pressure line changes into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is a tiger's head and a snake's tail: there is ill, but it is a sign of no blame.

units.title: 避乱·日辰制伏何妨卦里刑伤、月建临持勿谓爻中隐伏：鬼动克世但有日辰动爻克制冲散则有救，怕的是月建日辰带鬼刑克世爻，卦中无鬼也难免

rule.yi: 官鬼发动来刑克世爻，固然是凶兆，但如果有日辰、动爻克制、冲散它，都叫有救，必定不至于受害；只怕月建、日辰带着鬼来刑克世爻，即使卦中没有鬼，也免不了遭害。
rule.en: Pressure moving to punish or control the Self is of course an ill omen, but if the Day or a moving line restrains, controls or clashes it apart, all that is called rescue, and one will surely not be harmed; what is to be feared is the Month or the Day carrying Pressure and punishing or controlling the Self: even if the hexagram has no Pressure, one cannot escape harm.

yi: 有日辰制伏（鬼爻），
哪怕卦里有刑伤也无妨；
月建临在它上、持着（鬼爻），
就别说它在爻中隐伏
en: If the Day restrains it,
what matter if the hexagram has punishment and injury;
if the Month stands on it and holds it,
do not say it lies hidden in the lines

zh: 官鬼动来刑克世爻，固是凶兆，若得日辰动爻克制冲散之，皆谓有救，必不为守。
唯怕月建日辰带鬼刑克世爻，虽卦中无鬼，不免遭害。
yi: 官鬼发动来刑克世爻，固然是凶兆，但如果有日辰、动爻克制、冲散它，都叫有救，一定不至于受害。
只怕月建、日辰带着鬼来刑克世爻，即使卦中没有鬼，也免不了遭害。
en: Pressure moving to punish or control the Self is of course an ill omen, but if the Day or a moving line restrains, controls or clashes it apart, all that is called rescue, and one will surely not be harmed.
What is to be feared is the Month or the Day carrying Pressure and punishing or controlling the Self: even if the hexagram has no Pressure, one cannot escape harm.

note.yi: 注文第一句末尾的「必不为守」，按文意应是「必不为害」，译文按「必不至于受害」翻。
note.en: The words at the end of the note's first sentence, "surely not be keeping", should by the sense be "surely not be harmful", and the translation follows that.

units.title: 避乱·所恶者提起之神、所赖者死亡之地：鬼爻伏藏本吉，但被动爻日辰冲开、飞神提起仍被其害，只有鬼爻真空真破才许无灾

rule.yi: 鬼爻伏藏固然吉，但如果被动爻、日辰冲开，或者被飞神提起，伏神仍然受它的害；只有鬼爻是真空、真破，才许说没有灾。
rule.en: A hidden Pressure line is of course lucky, but if a moving line or the Day clashes it open, or the flying line raises it, the hidden line is still harmed by it; only if the Pressure line is truly Void or truly broken may one say there is no calamity.

yi: 所厌恶的是被提起的神（鬼），
所依赖的是它死亡的地方
en: What is feared is the spirit that gets raised up,
what is relied on is the place where it dies

zh: 鬼爻伏藏固吉，若被动爻日辰冲开，飞神提起，伏神仍被其害；
如鬼爻真空真破，方许无灾。
yi: 鬼爻伏藏固然吉，但如果被动爻、日辰冲开，飞神提起，伏神仍然被它所害；
如果鬼爻是真空、真破，才许说没有灾。
en: A hidden Pressure line is of course lucky, but if a moving line or the Day clashes it open, or the flying line raises it, the hidden line is still harmed by it;
only if the Pressure line is truly Void or truly broken may one say there is no calamity.

units.title: 避乱·自持鬼墓坟中不可潜藏、或值水神舟内犹当仔细：官鬼墓库的爻动来刑克或持世，不可躲坟墓；木鬼不躲草丛，水鬼不躲舟船，金鬼不躲寺观，火鬼不躲窑冶

rule.yi: 官鬼墓库的爻发动来刑克，或者持世，不可躲在坟墓里；木鬼不可躲在草丛里，水鬼不可躲在船里，金鬼不可躲在寺观里，火鬼不可躲在窑冶里。
rule.en: If the tomb line of Pressure moves to punish or control, or holds the Self, one must not hide inside a tomb; with Wood Pressure one must not hide in thickets, with Water Pressure in a boat, with Metal Pressure in a temple, with Fire Pressure in a kiln or smithy.

yi: 自己持着鬼的墓，
坟墓中不可潜藏；
或者逢到水神（鬼），
在船里还应当仔细
en: If the Self itself holds the tomb of Pressure,
one must not hide in a grave;
or if it meets a Water spirit,
one should still take care in a boat

zh: 官鬼墓库之爻动来刑克或持世是也，凡遇此象，不可避于坟墓内；
水鬼不可避于舟船，金鬼不可避于寺观，火鬼不可避于窑冶而已。
yi: 官鬼墓库的爻发动来刑克，或者持世，就是这样；凡遇到这个象，不可躲在坟墓里；
木鬼不可躲在草丛里；
水鬼不可躲在船里，金鬼不可躲在寺观里，火鬼不可躲在窑冶里，如此而已。
en: This is so when the tomb line of Pressure moves to punish or control, or holds the Self; whenever this image appears, one must not hide inside a tomb;
with Wood Pressure one must not hide in thickets;
with Water Pressure one must not hide in a boat, with Metal Pressure in a temple, with Fire Pressure in a kiln or smithy, and that is all.

units.title: 避乱·子爻福德北宜行、午象官爻南勿往：官鬼所临的方位是寇贼出入之处，宜避；子孙所临的地方是贼不到之处，宜往

rule.yi: 官鬼所临的方位，是寇贼出入的地方，应当躲开；子孙所临的地方，是贼不到的地方，适宜去。
rule.en: The quarter where Pressure stands is where the bandits come and go, and should be avoided; the place where Output stands is where the bandits do not come, and it is fit to go there.

yi: 子爻是福德，北方适宜去；
午象官爻在南，南方不要去
en: The Zi line is Output, and the north is fit to go to;
the Wu image is Pressure, and one must not go south

zh: 官鬼所临之方，乃寇出入之墟，宜避之；
子孙所临之地，乃贼不到之处，宜往之。
yi: 官鬼所临的方位，是寇贼出入的地方，应当躲开；
子孙所临的地方，是贼不到的地方，适宜去。
en: The quarter where Pressure stands is where the bandits come and go, and should be avoided;
the place where Output stands is where the bandits do not come, and it is fit to go there.

note.yi: 这一联是举例：子在北方、午在南方，子爻是福德就往北，午象是官鬼就别往南；换了别的卦，就换成别的方位。
note.en: This couplet is an example: Zi lies in the north and Wu in the south, so if the Zi line is Output go north, and if the Wu image is Pressure do not go south; in another hexagram the quarters change.

units.title: 避乱·鬼逢冲散何须克制之乡、福遇空亡莫若生扶之地：子孙之方固吉；福静官动而卦内有冲散官爻者取冲散之方；子孙空伏衰静受制又无冲散者取生世合世之方

rule.yi: 子孙所在的方位固然吉，因为它能制鬼，发动就取它；如果福静官动，而卦里有冲散官爻的，就以冲散它的方位为吉；如果子孙空亡、伏藏、衰弱安静受制，而鬼爻又没有被冲散，宜取生世、合世的方位为吉。
rule.en: The quarter of Output is of course lucky because it controls Pressure, and if it moves one takes it; if Output is still and Pressure moves, and something in the hexagram clashes the Pressure line apart, take the quarter that clashes it apart as lucky; if Output is Void, hidden, weak and still and controlled, and the Pressure line is not clashed apart, take the quarter that gives life to or combines with the Self as lucky.

yi: 鬼爻被冲散，
何必再去克制它的那个方位；
福神遇到空亡，
不如去生扶（世）的地方
en: If Pressure is clashed apart,
why need one go to the quarter that controls it;
if Output meets Void,
better to go to the place that gives life and support

zh: 子孙之方固吉，以其制鬼故也，若发动则取之可也。
若福静官动，而卦内有冲散官爻者，即以冲散之方为吉，其为得用之神故也。
若子孙空伏，衰静受制，而鬼爻又无冲散者，宜取生世合世之方为吉。
yi: 子孙所在的方位固然吉，因为它能制住鬼，如果它发动就取这个方位就可以；
如果福静而官动，而卦里有冲散官爻的，就以冲散它的那个方位为吉，因为它是得用的神；
如果子孙空亡、伏藏、衰弱安静受制，而鬼爻又没有被冲散，宜取生世、合世的方位为吉。
en: The quarter of Output is of course lucky because it controls Pressure, and if it moves one may take that quarter;
if Output is still and Pressure moves, and something in the hexagram clashes the Pressure line apart, take the quarter that clashes it apart as lucky, since that is the spirit put to use;
if Output is Void, hidden, weak and still and controlled, and the Pressure line is not clashed apart, take the quarter that gives life to or combines with the Self as lucky.

units.title: 避乱·旺相内卦终来本境横行：占贼寇来不来本境，官鬼在本宫内卦发动必来，在他宫外卦则不侵境；持世临内卦直到我家，临外卦持应虽来不入我室；卦身也忌临

rule.yi: 占贼寇会不会来我的地界：官鬼在本宫、在内卦发动，必定来；在别的宫、在外卦，就不侵入地界。持世、临在内卦，直接到我家；临在外卦、持应，虽然来也不进我的屋室。卦身也忌讳官鬼临在上面。
rule.en: In divining whether bandits will come into my district: if Pressure moves in its own palace and in the inner trigram, they will surely come; in another palace or in the outer trigram, they do not enter the district. If it holds the Self and stands in the inner trigram, they come straight to my house; standing in the outer trigram and holding the Other, though they come they do not enter my rooms. The Body also fears Pressure standing on it.

yi: （鬼爻）旺相在内卦，
终究会来到本地横行
en: If Pressure is strong in the inner trigram,
in the end they come into one's own district and run riot

zh: 凡占贼寇来我境否，若官在本宫内卦发动，必来；
在他宫外卦，则不侵境也。
若持世临内卦，直到我家；
临外卦持应，虽来不入我室。
yi: 凡是占贼寇会不会来我的地界，如果官鬼在本宫、在内卦发动，必定来；
在别的宫、在外卦，就不侵入地界。
如果持世、临在内卦，直接到我家；
临在外卦、持应，虽然来也不进我的屋室。
卦身也忌讳官鬼临在它上。
en: In divining whether bandits will come into my district, if Pressure moves in its own palace and in the inner trigram, they will surely come;
in another palace or in the outer trigram, they do not enter the district.
If it holds the Self and stands in the inner trigram, they come straight to my house;
standing in the outer trigram and holding the Other, though they come they do not enter my rooms.
The Body also fears Pressure standing on it.

units.title: 避乱·动化退神必往他乡剽掠：官爻发动化退神则贼将往他处劫掠，化进神则寇必速到，宜急避

rule.yi: 官爻发动，如果化出退神，贼将到别处劫掠；如果化出进神，贼寇必定很快就到，应该赶快躲避。
rule.en: If the Pressure line moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, the bandits are going to plunder elsewhere; if it changes into an Advancing spirit, the bandits will surely arrive quickly and one should hurry to hide.

yi: （鬼爻）发动化出退神，
必定去别处抢掠
en: If it moves and changes into a Retreating spirit,
they will surely go to plunder elsewhere

zh: 官爻发动，若化退神，将往他处劫掠也；
如化进神，寇必速到，宜急避之。
yi: 官爻发动，如果化出退神，将要到别处劫掠；
如果化出进神，贼寇必定很快就到，应该赶快躲避。
en: If the Pressure line moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, they are going to plunder elsewhere;
if it changes into an Advancing spirit, the bandits will surely arrive quickly and one should hurry to hide.

units.title: 避乱·官连旺福合生身反凶为吉：官爻发动克世本遭毒手，若化出子孙制鬼，或发动的子孙、财爻反来生合世身，必因祸得福

rule.yi: 官爻发动克世，本来要遭毒手；如果得到化出子孙制住鬼，或者发动的子孙、财爻反来生合世身，必定因祸得福。
rule.en: If the Pressure line moves and controls the Self, one would fall into cruel hands; but if it changes into Output that controls Pressure, or a moving Output or Wealth line comes instead to give life to or combine with the Self and Body, one will surely turn disaster into blessing.

yi: 官鬼连着旺相的福神，合住并生到（世）身，
反而变凶为吉
en: If Pressure joined to a strong Output combines with and gives life to the Self,
ill turns to luck

zh: 官爻发动克世，必遭毒手，若得化出子孙制鬼，或动子财反来生合世身者，必然因祸致福。
yi: 官爻发动克世，必定遭到毒手；如果得到化出子孙制住鬼，或者发动的子孙、财爻反来生合世身，必定因祸得福。
en: If the Pressure line moves and controls the Self, one will surely fall into cruel hands; but if it changes into Output that controls Pressure, or a moving Output or Wealth line comes instead to give life to or combine with the Self and Body, one will surely turn disaster into blessing.

units.title: 避乱·阳化阴财刑克世弄假成真：官爻发动本不伤世，而发动的财爻反来伤世，必因贪得财物惹祸

rule.yi: 官爻发动，没有伤到世爻，而发动的财爻反过来伤到世爻，必定因为贪得财物而惹祸。
rule.en: If the Pressure line moves without injuring the Self, but a moving Wealth line comes instead to injure the Self, one will surely bring on trouble through greed for goods.

yi: 阳爻化出阴爻的财爻来刑克世，
就是弄假成真
en: If a yang line changes into a yin Wealth line that punishes or controls the Self,
what was pretence turns into earnest

zh: 官爻发动不伤世爻，而被动财反伤世爻者，必因贪得财物而惹祸也。
yi: 官爻发动，没有伤到世爻，而被动的财爻反过来伤到世爻，必定因为贪得财物而惹祸。
en: If the Pressure line moves without injuring the Self, but a moving Wealth line comes instead to injure the Self, one will surely bring on trouble through greed for goods.

units.title: 避乱·贼兴三合爻中必投陷井：最怕鬼动会成鬼局，贼寇四面合来，前遭后遇不能脱；两鬼俱动克世亦然；三合兄局失财物，父局防小儿，财局生合世则父母失散，子孙局克鬼最吉

rule.yi: 最怕发动的爻会成鬼局，贼寇从四面合围而来，想躲避也前遭后遇，不能脱身；卦里有两个鬼爻都发动克世也是这样。三合成兄弟局，人没事但财物失散；三合成父母局，要仔细照看小孩；三合成财局生合世爻，主父母失散；三合成子孙局而克制鬼爻，最吉。
rule.en: Most to be feared is a moving line meeting into a Pressure frame, so that the bandits close in from all sides and, however one wants to hide, one is met in front and caught behind and cannot get free; two Pressure lines both moving to control the Self is the same. A three-harmony Peer frame leaves the person unharmed but his goods scattered; a three-harmony Resource frame calls for care of the small children; a three-harmony Wealth frame giving life to or combining with the Self means the parents are scattered; a three-harmony Output frame that controls the Pressure line is the most auspicious.

yi: 贼寇在三合的爻中兴起，
必定落入陷阱
en: If the bandits rise in a three-harmony frame,
one will surely fall into the pit

zh: 最怕动会鬼局，必主贼寇四边合来，虽欲避之，前遭后遇不能脱离。
卦有两鬼俱动克世，亦然三合兄局，身虽无事，财物失散；
三合财局生合世爻，则主父母失散；
三合子孙局克制鬼爻，为最吉也。
yi: 最怕发动会成鬼局，必定主贼寇从四面合拢而来，虽然想躲避，前面遭遇后面碰上，不能脱离。
卦里有两个鬼爻都发动克世，也是这样；三合成兄弟局，人虽然没事，财物会失散；
三合成父母局，要仔细照看小孩；
三合成财局，生合世爻，就主父母失散；
三合成子孙局，克制鬼爻，最吉。
en: Most to be feared is a moving line meeting into a Pressure frame, which means the bandits close in from all four sides: though one wishes to avoid them, one is met in front and caught behind and cannot get free.
If the hexagram has two Pressure lines both moving to control the Self, it is the same; a three-harmony Peer frame leaves the person unharmed but his goods scattered and lost;
a three-harmony Resource frame calls for care of the small children;
a three-harmony Wealth frame giving life to or combining with the Self means the parents are scattered;
a three-harmony Output frame that controls the Pressure line is the most auspicious.

note.yi: 注文里的「兄局」「父局」是兄弟局、父母局的简称；「身虽无事，财物失散」说的是人没事、东西丢了。
note.en: In the note "Peer frame" and "Resource frame" are short for the frames of Peer and Resource lines; "the person is unharmed but his goods scattered" means the man comes through but his things are lost.

units.title: 避乱·身在六旬空处终脱樊笼：身、世落空亡，躲避为吉

rule.yi: 身爻、世爻落在空亡，躲避就吉，最终能脱出牢笼。
rule.en: If the Body and the Self fall into Void, hiding is lucky, and one at last escapes the cage.

yi: 身落在六旬的空处，
终究能脱出牢笼
en: If the Body falls in a Void place among the six decades,
one at last escapes the cage

yi: 身、世落空亡，躲避就吉。
en: If the Body and the Self fall into Void, hiding is lucky.

units.title: 避乱·官鬼临身任尔潜踪犹撞见：官爻持世就是寇贼临身，无法躲避；被捉去以后才占也脱不了

rule.yi: 官爻持世，就是寇贼已经临到自己身上，怎么能躲避？如果是被捉去以后才占的，也不能脱离他们回来。
rule.en: A Pressure line holding the Self is the bandits at one's very person; how can one hide? If one divines after being seized, one still cannot get away from them and return.

yi: 官鬼临在身上，
任你隐藏行踪也还是会撞见
en: If Pressure stands on the Self,
however you hide your tracks you will still run into them

zh: 官爻持世乃是寇贼临身，如何可避？
如至捉去而占，亦不能脱彼而回。
yi: 官爻持世，就是寇贼临身，怎么能躲避？
如果是被抓去以后才占的，也不能脱离他们回来。
en: A Pressure line holding the Self is the bandits at one's very person; how can one hide?
If one divines after being seized, one still cannot get away from them and return.

units.title: 避乱·子孙持世纵然对面不相逢：子孙持世不动也吉发动更妙，临月建、带日辰或在旁爻旺动都吉，卦中虽有鬼动也不足畏

rule.yi: 子孙持世，不动也吉，发动更妙；如果临月建，或者带日辰，或者在旁边的爻旺相发动，都吉；卦中即使有鬼爻发动，也不足畏惧，纵然面对面也碰不上。
rule.en: Output holding the Self is lucky even if still, and better still if it moves; if it stands on the Month or carries the Day, or is strong and moving in another line, all is lucky; even if Pressure moves in the hexagram it is not to be feared, and even face to face they will not meet.

yi: 子孙持世，
纵然面对面也碰不上
en: If Output holds the Self,
even face to face they will not meet

zh: 子孙持世，不动亦吉，发动尤妙。
若临月建或带日辰，或在旁爻旺动，皆吉，卦中虽有鬼动，不足畏也。
yi: 子孙持世，不动也吉，发动更妙。
如果临月建，或者带日辰，或者在旁边的爻旺相发动，都吉，卦中即使有鬼爻发动，也不足畏惧。
en: Output holding the Self is lucky even if still, and better still if it moves.
If it stands on the Month or carries the Day, or is strong and moving in another line, all is lucky; even if Pressure moves in the hexagram it is not to be feared.

units.title: 避乱·兄变官爻窃恐乡人劫掠：卦中无鬼而兄弟发动变出鬼爻，要防邻人乘机劫盗，不是真贼寇；兄在内卦是近邻，在外卦是远方人

rule.yi: 卦中没有鬼爻，而遇到兄弟发动变出鬼爻来，要提防邻居趁机劫盗财物，并不是真的贼寇；兄弟在内卦是近邻，在外卦是远方的人。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Pressure but a moving Peer line changes into a Pressure line, guard against neighbours seizing the chance to rob and steal goods, and not true bandits; Peer in the inner trigram is a near neighbour, in the outer trigram a person from afar.

yi: 兄弟爻变出官鬼爻，
恐怕有同乡的人来劫掠
en: If Peer changes into a Pressure line,
I fear fellow villagers will come to plunder

zh: 卦中无鬼而遇兄动变出者，须防邻人乘机劫盗财物，非真贼寇也；
兄在内卦，是近邻，在外卦，远方人也。
yi: 卦中没有鬼，而遇到兄弟发动变出鬼来，要提防邻居趁机劫盗财物，并不是真的贼寇；
兄弟在内卦，是近邻；在外卦，是远方的人。
en: If the hexagram has no Pressure but a moving Peer changes into it, guard against neighbours seizing the chance to rob and steal goods, and not true bandits;
Peer in the inner trigram is a near neighbour; in the outer trigram, a person from afar.

units.title: 避乱·财连鬼煞须防臧获私藏：卦中无鬼而财爻变出官爻，是奴婢假冒盗贼劫物，或乱中被藏匿；在外卦是邻居的妇人

rule.yi: 卦中没有鬼，财爻变出官爻的，是奴婢假冒盗贼劫物，或者在乱中被他们藏匿了东西；如果在外卦，是邻居的妇人。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Pressure and Wealth changes into a Pressure line, it is servants posing as thieves to carry things off, or things hidden away by them in the confusion; if it is in the outer trigram, it is a woman of the neighbourhood.

yi: 财爻连着鬼煞，
要提防奴婢私自藏匿
en: If Wealth is linked with baleful Pressure,
guard against slaves and maids secretly hiding things

zh: 卦中无鬼，财变官爻者，是奴婢假盗贼劫物，或在乱中被其其藏匿也；
yi: 卦中没有鬼，财爻变出官爻的，是奴婢假冒盗贼劫物，或者在乱中被他们藏匿了东西；
如果在外卦，是邻居的妇人。
en: If the hexagram has no Pressure and Wealth changes into a Pressure line, it is servants posing as thieves to carry things off, or things hidden away by them in the confusion;
if it is in the outer trigram, it is a woman of the neighbourhood.

units.title: 避乱·日辰冲克财爻妻孥失散、动象刑伤福德儿女拋离：官动必有惊险，日辰动爻伤到的地方不太平，冲克财爻则妻孥失散，冲克子孙则儿女被抛离

rule.yi: 官鬼发动必定有惊险，不论日辰、动爻，被它伤到的地方就不太平：如果冲克财爻，主妻子儿女失散；如果冲克子孙，必定儿女被抛离。
rule.en: If Pressure moves there is surely alarm and danger, and whatever the Day or a moving line, the place it injures is unsettled: if it clashes with or controls the Wealth line, wife and children are scattered; if it clashes with or controls Output, the sons and daughters are surely cast away.

yi: 日辰冲克财爻，
妻子儿女失散；
动象刑伤福德，
儿女被抛离
en: If the Day clashes with or controls the Wealth line,
wife and children are scattered;
if a moving image punishes or injures Output,
the sons and daughters are cast away

zh: 官动必有惊险，不拘日辰动爻被其伤处即不太平。
如冲克财爻，主妻孥失散；
冲克子孙，必主儿女抛离。
yi: 官鬼发动必定有惊险，不论日辰、动爻，被它伤到的地方就不太平。
如果冲克财爻，主妻子儿女失散；
冲克子孙，必定儿女被抛离。
en: If Pressure moves there is surely alarm and danger, and whatever the Day or a moving line, the place it injures is unsettled.
if it clashes with or controls the Wealth line, wife and children are scattered;
if it clashes with or controls Output, the sons and daughters are surely cast away.
